label: GA-MCTS development-only tuning grid (predeclared before any GA-MCTS model run; DEV = 20 exposed 3D roots, r53.panel('3d'))
population: PUBLIC_dev_3d.jsonl (20 exposed DEV roots; public rows only)
outcome: DEV learned energy of the SELECTED plan (planners.select, floor + NOOP gate) and incumbent time only; no physical verification on DEV
reference: E*_r = min selected-plan energy for root r over every DEV trajectory (the GA 180 s DEV trajectory + all grid runs, all budgets)
regret: regret_r(b) = E_sel_r(b) - E*_r; NOOP roots (p_noop >= 0.5, identical for every arm) excluded; no incumbent -> E = 60
selection_rule: argmin over configs of mean_{roots, b in budgets} regret; configs within 0.01 of the best are tied -> smaller median time-to-final-incumbent (first trace time reaching the 30 s incumbent energy), then smaller c, then FULL before PW
